nodes.label: Unverified hourly lineage and historical source vintages
nodes.rationale: Hourly averaging, interval labels, revisions and original RTE/weather/demand issue archives are unverified. Interval-start, hourly mean-power and interval-end-plus-two-hour availability assumptions define a retrospective benchmark; timestamp agreement does not prove equal intervals or operational availability.

nodes.label: Previously exposed test, preserved targets and business limits
nodes.rationale: Prior EDA exposed the chronological test. Missing targets, peaks and country/regional discrepancies remain reported rather than silently corrected. National demand is a portfolio proxy; no price/settlement/procurement evidence supports euro savings or quarter-hour market alignment.
